commit_message: Fix MCP protocol negotiation for Codex
pr_title: GameEngine: fix Codex MCP protocol negotiation
pr_body:
## Summary

- negotiate the Codex-compatible MCP 2025-06-18 protocol instead of forcing one process-wide version
- accept both the existing GameEngine protocol version and the compatible Codex legacy version on sessionless Streamable HTTP requests
- cover Editor-attached and shared MCP host transports with regression tests

## Validation

Run through permanent Windows Validation.
